```yaml
name: E2E Portals

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  e2e-portals:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      # ------------------------------------------------------------------
      # Rust setup and caching
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        uses: dsherret/rust-toolchain-file@v1
        id: rust

      - name: Cache Cargo registry and git
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-

      # ------------------------------------------------------------------
      # Build binaries
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Build tavern
        run: cargo build --release -p tavern

      - name: Build imixv2
        run: cargo build --release -p imixv2

      - name: Build socks5
        run: cargo build --release -p socks5

      # ------------------------------------------------------------------
      # Start services
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Start tavern
        run: |
          ./target/release/tavern > tavern.log 2>&1 &
          echo $! > tavern.pid
        env:
          RUST_LOG: info

      - name: Start imixv2
        run: |
          ./target/release/imixv2 > imix.log 2>&1 &
          echo $! > imix.pid
        env:
          RUST_LOG: info

      - name: Wait for services to be ready
        run: sleep 5

      # ------------------------------------------------------------------
      # Node & Playwright setup
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm

      - name: Install Playwright dependencies
        run: |
          npm ci
          npx playwright install --with-deps

      # ------------------------------------------------------------------
      # Run Playwright test
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Run Playwright e2e test
        run: npx playwright test tests/e2e/tests/portal.spec.ts
        env:
          TAVERN_URL: http://localhost:8080
          IMIX_URL: http://localhost:8081
          # The test script will set up the SOCKS5 proxy and mock HTTP server
          # and perform the file transfer verification.

      # ------------------------------------------------------------------
      # Cleanup
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Stop tavern
        if: always()
        run: |
          if [ -f tavern.pid ]; then kill $(cat tavern.pid); fi

      - name: Stop imixv2
        if: always()
        run: |
          if [ -f imix.pid ]; then kill $(cat imix.pid); fi

      - name: Stop SOCKS5 proxy
        if: always()
        run: |
          if [ -f socks5.pid ]; then kill $(cat socks5.pid); fi

      - name: Stop mock HTTP server
        if: always()
        run: |
          if [ -f httpserver.pid ]; then kill $(cat httpserver.pid); fi

      - name: Teardown Linux
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/teardown-linux@main
        with:
          skip-wait-ssh: true
```
